fields.title: Steam sale / discount record
fields.description: recordType is DEAL, DAILY_DEAL, SPOTLIGHT, FEATURED_SPECIAL, FREEBIE, APP_PRICE, SALE_PAGE, SALE_ITEM, SALE_EVENT, DEAL_ENDED or ERROR. Fields without a value are null; extra fields may appear.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The input value (mode:country, game, sale URL) that produced this record.

_source.title: Source
_source.description: Endpoint that produced the record (S1-store-search-specials, S1-store-search-free, S1-featured-dailydeal, S1-featured-spotlight, S1-featured-specials, S1-store-appdetails, S1-sale-page, S1-sale-page+getitems, S1-steamworks-upcoming-events, S1-snapshot-diff) or 'none' for errors.

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 time the record was produced.

recordType.title: Record type
recordType.description: DEAL, DAILY_DEAL, SPOTLIGHT, FEATURED_SPECIAL, FREEBIE, APP_PRICE, SALE_PAGE, SALE_ITEM, SALE_EVENT, DEAL_ENDED or ERROR.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Only on ERROR records: invalid_input, not_found, no_results, search_failed, blocked or unexpected_shape.

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Only on ERROR records: what went wrong.

country.title: Country
country.description: Store country the price is for.

totalDiscounted.title: Total discounted
totalDiscounted.description: DEAL: how many discounted items Steam reports for these filters.

sortOrder.title: Sort order
sortOrder.description: DEAL: order 'position' refers to. A run that reads the whole list walks it by name (the only stable order).

itemKey.title: Item key
itemKey.description: Steam item key: App_<appid>, Sub_<packageid> or Bundle_<bundleid>.

appid.title: App ID
appid.description: Steam appid (null for packages and bundles).

isFreeToKeep.title: Free to keep
isFreeToKeep.description: Limited-time giveaway: claim it at $0 and keep it.

priceSource.title: Price source
priceSource.description: search = store search row; store_api = Steam's store API (used when search shows no price).

includedAppids.title: Included appids
includedAppids.description: Apps contained in a package row.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: ISO currency of the price fields.

originalPrice.title: Original price
originalPrice.description: Price before discount in currency units.

finalPriceCents.title: Price (cents)
finalPriceCents.description: Current price in Steam's integer cents (whole-unit currencies are also x100).

originalPriceCents.title: Original price (cents)
originalPriceCents.description: Original price in Steam's integer cents.

originalPriceFormatted.title: Original price (formatted)
originalPriceFormatted.description: Original price as Steam displays it.

finalPriceUsd.title: Price (USD)
finalPriceUsd.description: Current price converted to USD with ECB reference rates (null if the currency is not covered).

fxRateDate.title: FX rate date
fxRateDate.description: Date of the ECB rates used for USD conversion.

priceAvailable.title: Price available
priceAvailable.description: false when Steam lists the item without a purchasable price (free, unreleased, not sold in this country).

isBundleDiscount.title: Owner bundle discount
isBundleDiscount.description: Row price includes an extra 'complete the set' discount.

releaseDate.title: Release date
releaseDate.description: Release date text from the store.

tagIds.title: Tag IDs
tagIds.description: Steam tag ids of the item.

storeItemFound.title: Store item found
storeItemFound.description: false when the official store API had no record for the item.

itemName.title: Store API name
itemName.description: Name from the official store API.

discountEndsAt.title: Discount ends
discountEndsAt.description: UTC time the current discount ends.

discountEndsAtUnix.title: Discount ends (unix)
discountEndsAtUnix.description: Discount end as a Unix timestamp.

hoursLeft.title: Hours left
hoursLeft.description: Hours until the discount or sale ends.

discountType.title: Deal type
discountType.description: Steam preset (special, weekend, daily, midweek, launch, prepurchase, ...), free_to_keep, or named_campaign.

discountLabel.title: Campaign name
discountLabel.description: Name of a publisher campaign, e.g. 'Two Point Franchise - Weekend Deal'.

purchaseOptionName.title: Purchase option
purchaseOptionName.description: Name of the cheapest purchase option.

finalPriceCentsGetItems.title: Price (store API)
finalPriceCentsGetItems.description: Final price in cents from the store API.

originalPriceCentsGetItems.title: Original price (store API)
originalPriceCentsGetItems.description: Original price in cents from the store API.

hideDiscountPctForCompliance.title: Discount % hidden
hideDiscountPctForCompliance.description: Steam hides the % for legal reasons in this region.

purchaseOptionsCount.title: Purchase options
purchaseOptionsCount.description: Number of ways to buy the item.

discountedPurchaseOptions.title: Discounted purchase options
discountedPurchaseOptions.description: [{name, packageId, bundleId, finalPriceCents, originalPriceCents, discountPct, bundleDiscountPct}]

spotlightName.title: Spotlight
spotlightName.description: Storefront spotlight title (WEEKEND DEAL, Free Weekend, FRANCHISE SALE, ...).

spotlightBody.title: Spotlight text
spotlightBody.description: Spotlight body text (Steam leaves %1$s placeholders unresolved).

discountExpiresAt.title: Discount expires
discountExpiresAt.description: FEATURED_SPECIAL: discount expiry from the storefront feed.

clanSteamId.title: Organiser
clanSteamId.description: Steam group id of the organiser.

eventType.title: Event type
eventType.description: SALE_EVENT: seasonal_sale, themed_fest, next_fest. SALE_PAGE: Steam event type number.

saleItemCount.title: Sale items
saleItemCount.description: SPOTLIGHT: items listed on the sale page.

capsuleType.title: Capsule type
capsuleType.description: SALE_ITEM: game, dlc, music, sub, bundle.

sectionIndex.title: Section
sectionIndex.description: SALE_ITEM: index of the page section.

cheapestCountry.title: Cheapest country
cheapestCountry.description: APP_PRICE: country with the lowest USD price among those requested.

cheapestPriceUsd.title: Cheapest price (USD)
cheapestPriceUsd.description: APP_PRICE: lowest USD price among the countries.

vsUsPricePct.title: vs US price %
vsUsPricePct.description: APP_PRICE: difference to the US price (US must be in countries).

status.title: Status
status.description: SALE_EVENT: upcoming, live, ended or tbd.

startTimeNote.title: Start time
startTimeNote.description: SALE_EVENT: Steam switches sales at 10:00 Pacific Time.

previousFinalPriceCents.title: Previous price (cents)
previousFinalPriceCents.description: Monitoring: price at the previous run.

priceChangeCents.title: Price change (cents)
priceChangeCents.description: Monitoring: change since the previous run.

priceDropPct.title: Price drop %
priceDropPct.description: Monitoring: drop since the previous run.

previousDiscountPct.title: Previous discount %
previousDiscountPct.description: Monitoring: discount at the previous run.

isNewDeal.title: New deal
isNewDeal.description: Monitoring: discounted now, not discounted (or absent) last run.

firstSeenAt.title: First seen
firstSeenAt.description: Monitoring: first run that saw the item.

lowestPriceSeenCents.title: Lowest price seen (cents)
lowestPriceSeenCents.description: Monitoring: lowest price over all runs of this task.

lowestPriceSeenAt.title: Lowest seen at
lowestPriceSeenAt.description: Monitoring: when the lowest price was observed.

isLowestPriceSeen.title: At lowest seen
isLowestPriceSeen.description: Monitoring: current price equals the lowest ever seen by this task.

alert.title: Alert
alert.description: Monitoring: new deal or price drop >= threshold.

lastSeenAt.title: Last seen
lastSeenAt.description: DEAL_ENDED: last run the deal was live.
